The Rundeck REST API provides programmatic access to all Rundeck functionality including job management, execution control, project administration, node management, user management, ACL policies, system administration, and cluster operations. The current API version is 58. Rundeck is an open source runbook automation service developed by PagerDuty that enables IT teams to run automation tasks across nodes, manage self-service operations, and maintain execution history.
